brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net small platformer RPG based on Wikipedia where you play as the character BABY SIGMA GLOBE, a screenshot of which is in this post bsky.app/profile/dept... and the actual jpeg of which is located here commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:BA...

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@eva.computer: rpg where you play as this
  [quoting @depthsofwikipedia.bsky.social: thank you to the volunteer who added the baby wikipedia globe "doing a mewing or sigma face" to commons it truly takes a village (image, no alt text)]

[from the harness, not the requester] 1 image from this thread is attached to this build as a file — you can see it. If someone asks whether you can see their screenshot, the answer is yes.

[from the harness, not the requester] These images were in the thread but could
NOT be downloaded, so you do NOT have them. Don't describe or guess at their
contents. If they matter to the request, say in your reply that you couldn't
fetch them and ask for a description.
- https://cdn.bsky.app/img/feed_fullsize/plain/did:plc:cyyd366g3hrxp5rynixm2mm3/bafkreihog2rvho6ccq2uy67dnrukh25xpxsihxkeohtybgcpcncmmp5h7i@jpeg (came back as , not an image)
note: Built a Wikipedia-flavoured platformer RPG: you're the baby globe (jaw: defined), with quests, level-ups and a boss. Couldn't fetch the image so I drew the globe myself. #NaNoFoMo
